# STE. MOUAWAD — Entreprise Artistique (شركة معوض للأعمال الفنية)

> Family-run Lebanese workshop hand-crafting all kinds of stonework in marble and natural stone since 1967: church interiors, altars, fireplaces, columns, balusters, sculpture, fountains and hand-carved details. Based in Mazraat Yachouh, Metn, Mount Lebanon. Works across Lebanon and beyond.

## About
- Founded: 1967; still family-run today
- Location: Mazraat Yachouh, Metn, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon
- Materials: natural stone and marble
- Clients: churches and parishes, homeowners, architects, interior designers, contractors
- Service area: Lebanon and international projects
- Languages: Arabic, English, French

## What they make
All kinds of handcrafted stonework, including:
- Church interiors: sanctuaries, niches and complete interior stonework for new churches and restorations
- Altars and devotional pieces: carved altars, tabernacles and devotional elements
- Fireplaces: classic carved mantels to minimalist modern surrounds, made to measure
- Columns and balusters: fluted columns, capitals, hand-turned balusters
- Sculpture and carved details: medallions, crosses, reliefs, one-of-a-kind pieces
- Gardens and outdoor: stone fountains, outdoor barbecues, garden features

## Process
Design → technical drawings → stone selection → hand craftsmanship in the workshop → installation on site.
